articleTitle: Uav Path Planning Based on Improved Artificial Potential Field Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: At present, the research on UAV mission planning mainly focuses on traditional $\text{A}^{\star}$ algorithm, artificial potential field method, $\text{D}^{\star}$ algorithm and some early popular intelligent algorithms, such as ant colony algorithm, particle swarm algorithm, genetic algorithm and so on. To solve the artificial potential field method in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) route planning for obstacles and target distance too close without gravitational repulsion and only lead to target unreachable, UAV repulsive force and force of the net force is zero, not to the target point close to the problems, put forward an improved artificial potential field algorithm, we first by improved artificial potential field method in the repulsive force function, In the repulsive function, the attraction of UAV to the target point is introduced by obstacles to solve the problems of local optimization and unreachable target point. Then, the repulsive potential field of UAV boundary is established to limit the driving area of UAV, and the influence of UAV speed and repulsive potential field is properly considered. Finally, the effectiveness of the improved method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Automatic Driving Scene Target Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5 Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Target detection algorithm has become more and more important in the field of automatic driving. It is the most difficult to balance the high precision target detection and high speed processing time in target detection algorithm. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv5 algorithm to comprehensively improve the accuracy and operation speed of target detection in automatic driving scenarios. In this paper, DCN network is introduced in the neural network model to replace the CNN layer in YOLOv5, and the fine feature extraction of images is realized in the backbone feature extraction layer. In addition, in the selection of anchor points, K-means++ clustering algorithm is adopted in this paper to replace the K-means algorithm in the original algorithm to achieve faster and more accurate selection of anchor frames. At the same time, DIOU is introduced as the regression loss of the prediction box, which accelerates the convergence speed of the algorithm. The improved algorithm has improved mAP on KITTI dataset and COCO dataset. Therefore, this paper can achieve target detection that is more suitable for automatic driving scenarios.

articleTitle: Fault Line Selection of Resonant Grounding System Using Transient Zero-sequence Current Waveform Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: For medium-voltage distribution network, the main fault form is single-phase grounding fault, and the fault rate accounts for more than 80% of the total faults in the power grid. The long-term existence of faults may cause multi-point faults and phase-to-phase short circuits, and even cause a fire in the cable channel, threatening personal life safety. In this paper, the fault line is judged according to the phase difference of the transient zero-sequence current waveform, and the similarity of the waveform is visualized with the help of the dynamic time warping distance, and the line selection criterion is constructed. Finally, the simulation results are built to verify the applicability of the criterion under different fault conditions. The results show that this method can accurately select fault lines under different transition resistances, fault locations and arc suppression coil compensation degrees, and has certain applicability.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Image Dehazing Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Image dehazing is an important part of the field of computer vision, and it is also one of the widely used technologies in reality. It has developed rapidly in recent years and has been widely promoted at both hardware and software levels. Dehazing the construction site image for the group of construction workers can ensure the control of the site by the background monitoring during the haze weather, discover the relevant safety hazards on the site in time, and protect the safety and interests of the construction workers. This paper studies and improves the shortcomings of the existing dehazing methods. Compared with the traditional algorithm and the existing deep learning dehazing algorithm, the dehazing effect of the deep learning model used is closer to the clear image in the visual sense. At the same time, a dehazing model based on generative adversarial network is designed. The generator is a convolutional network equipped with a residual short-circuit structure. The discriminator introduces an attention mechanism and performs Fourier transform on the generated image and the real image. The model has certain universality and can be applied to image dehazing in other fields.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Blockchain Technology in the Weapon and Equipment Testing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Blockchain technology has a broad application prospect in the military field due to its advanced technical concept, and as an important link in the development of the weapon and equipment, the testing plays a key role in the process of development, production and combat force formation. As a new application model of computer technology such as distributed data storage, peer-to-peer transmission, consensus mechanism, cryptographic algorithms, blochchain is strongly correlated with the weapon and equipment in command and control, data management, security and confidentiality, and has great potential for application in the weapon and equipment testing. Aiming at the application of blockchain technology in the weapon and equipment testing, this paper introduced the concept and principle of blockchain technology, described the characteristics of blockchain technology, and then analyzed the application scenarios and methods of blockchain technology in the weapon and equipment testing, such as test command and control, data management, security and confidentiality according to the advantages of its technology application. Combining with the limitations of blockchain technology itself, the problems that need to be solved such as the large scale of network nodes, storage space requirements, and bearer network densities being not equal were analyzed, and the challenges that blockchian may face such as the poor compatibility of deployment methods, the low response speed and the conflict with centralized control were studied. In the end, suggestions were made for the application and development of blockchain technology in the weapon and equipment testing in the future.

articleTitle: Based on End-to-End Object Detection Algorithm with Transformers for Detecting Wafer Maps
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the gradual increasing of wafer fabrication yield, defect pattern recognition in wafer maps becomes more challenging, and thus it is especially important to identify problems in the process as early as possible to avoid waste, and new ideas are provided in deep learning for defect pattern recognition (DPR) of wafer maps. In this paper, an End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers is introduced to process wafer defect maps by migrating the learning weights and fine-tuning the parameters. The test results show that the DETR based algorithm for wafer detection improves 8.4% in accuracy compared to the improved Mask R-CNN detector.

articleTitle: Research on Low-altitude UAV Aerial Photography Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low detection accuracy and missed detection in low altitude UAV aerial photography target detection, a target detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5 is proposed in this paper. The algorithm uses K-Means++ algorithm to redesign the prior frame size and match it to the corresponding feature layer; by using CIoU instead of GIoU as the loss function of target frame regression, the target detection accuracy is improved. The improved algorithm is applied to low-altitude UAV aerial image detection, and the experimental results show that the algorithm has stronger feature extraction ability and higher detection accuracy than the original YOLOv5 algorithm for low-altitude UAV aerial photography target detection. Target detection in aerial photography of UAV is the basis of target tracking, autonomous obstacle avoidance and other tasks, which has important scientific significance and practical value.

articleTitle: Image Fusion Algorithm Based on Laplacian Pyramid and Principal Component Analysis Transforms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Herein, a novel image fusion algorithm based on Laplacian pyramid transform and principal component analysis (PCA) is proposed. In this algorithm, a multi-resolution transform called Laplacian pyramid transform is used to decompose the original image into sub-images. In the transform domain, the coefficients of the various sub-images are combined using a novel fusion rule that utilizes the PCA technique. Finally, the new coefficients are used in the reconstruction of the fused image. Numerical simulations are performed to test the validity and capability of the proposed fusion algorithm. The average gradient values of PCA fusion, Laplacian pyramid fusion, and the proposed fusion method, are tested, respectively. The average gradient values of the proposed method are larger than the other two methods, especially for the spectral bands over 600nm. The three methods performed a bit inferior between the 500nm and 600nm bands compared to the other spectral bands. The Laplacian pyramid transform fusion algorithm seems relatively stable, but it is obvious that the proposed fusion algorithm has a superior performance in the visible range. Moreover, the principal component of the original image was utilized, thus, preserving the spectral information of the hyperspectral image.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability of XSS Based on International Student Website
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The international student website is the window of the school's external publicity. Through the website, international students can understand the school in a wider range and in all aspects. The website is often attacked by network hackers. How to ensure the security of the website? Cross site scripting attack (XSS) is the most common web application security vulnerability. Through the analysis of cross site scripting attack (XSS), this paper puts forward the preventive methods for input verification, output coding, clearly specifying the coding mode of output, paying attention to the limitations of blacklist verification mode, being alert to standardization errors, and gives examples of not inserting untrusted data in the allowed position, and HTML coding these data when inserting untrusted data between HTML tags, Before inserting untrusted data into common HTML attributes, encode HTML attributes; before inserting untrusted data into HTML JavaScript, encode JavaScript; before inserting untrusted data into HTML style attribute values, encode CSS; before inserting untrusted data into HTML URL attributes, encode URL; when using rich text, use XSS rule engine to encode and filter and other corresponding defense rules.

articleTitle: News Recommendation Algorithm Based on Multiple Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Today, with the rapid development of the Internet, the channels for people to obtain news are more and more diversified, and the number of online news is also increasing rapidly. However, it is more and more difficult for users to find the news that they are interested in. Therefore, personalized news the recommendation system is of great significance. In view of the fact that the current news recommendation system fails to fully consider the semantic information of news and the singleness of the modeling factors of news text, it cannot fully consider the semantic information of news and cannot accurately vectorize the information of news content, we propose News Recommendation Algorithm Based on Multiple Perspectives (BTEC). The model using the Bert model and attention to vectorize the body, title, event in the news respectively, and the dense layer is used to vectorize the news categories. then according to this four perspective are fused to process the candidate news and user browsing news data, respectively to obtain the corresponding candidate news vectorization and user vectorization, and dot multiplication them to obtain the probability of users clicking on the candidate news. that is, the news recommendation result. Experimental data show that BTEC improves the F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> index by about 8% compared with the other news recommendation algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Early Warning System of College Students' Mental Health Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of education quality, the importance of College Students' mental health is more and more obvious in college education. For the mental health management of college students, we should not only establish a system database to store data sources, but should reasonably apply the data sources to upgrade the data to an objective, visual and predictable level, so as to prepare for a rainy day. This study applies big data related technologies to the field of College Students' mental health, and carries out early warning and intervention on College Students' mental health through data thinking and methods. The system provides an intelligent solution based on data thinking for preventing college students' mental diseases, enhancing college students' management ability and improving students' physical and mental health.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Algorithm of Printing Machine Rolling Bearing Based on Hilbert Envelope Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the development of the society, the printing machine undertakes more tasks and puts forward higher requirements for its printing performance. Therefore, real-time diagnosis and detection of printing machine faults is of great significance to reduce economic losses and ensure the safety of staff. At present, fuzzy fault diagnosis method and fault tree analysis method are the main diagnostic methods, which cannot realize real-time fault monitoring and cannot guarantee the accuracy of diagnosis. This paper proposed the vibration signal diagnosis algorithm based on Hilbert envelope spectrum. First of all, algorithm uses the vibration signals of the printing machine to decompose of the wavelet in time domain. The time domain component with the largest kurtosis value is used for Hilbert envelope spectrum transformation. The algorithm obtains the peak frequency of the envelope spectrum by analyzing the Hilbert envelope spectrum. Finally, the diagnosis conclusion is drawn by comparing the frequency with the fault frequency. Experimental verification of the vibration signals of the inner and outer rings of the printing machine was carried out based on the public data provided by Case Western Reserve University. The results show that the proposed algorithm has high accuracy and can monitor the faults of the printing machine online in real time.

articleTitle: Research on Garbage Image Classification Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the advent of the global information era, the traditional waste image sorting algorithm can no longer meet the needs of modern urban waste sorting, and modern society has an increasingly strong desire for intelligent automation of waste image sorting technology. Therefore, the research and innovation of waste image sorting technology are essential for the development of the computer field and the modernization process of society. For garbage image classification, to solve the problem of garbage classification, a pre-trained ResNet34 model with migration parameters based on the ImageNet dataset is proposed in this paper to solve this problem. The model uses batch normalization to improve network stability and accelerate network convergence. At the same time, a lightweight CBAM attention mechanism module is added to enhance the focus on the main features of images and ignore irrelevant features to improve network performance further. The experimental results show that the performance of the improved model is considerably improved, and the performance results are better on the relevant garbage classification dataset, which has some practical value.

articleTitle: The Application of Artificial Intelligence in Accounting
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the penetration of artificial intelligence into the accounting field, accounting work has ushered in great development and also faces some challenges. This paper comes out from the concept of artificial intelligence, analyzes the advantages of using artificial intelligence in accounting work to improve work efficiency, improve the reliability of accounting information, reduce fraud, and the disadvantages of leaking trade secrets, unclear responsibility, technical risks, etc., and further elaborates the application of artificial intelligence in accounting work such as self-made or foreign original documents, inventory management, payroll accounting, financial accounting, financial analysis, financial budgeting, etc., hoping to bring help to the development of accounting work and thus promote the development of enterprises.

articleTitle: Research Scheme of Oral Implant Navigation Surgery Based on Aruco Marker
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of computer technology, sensor target location tracking technology has been successfully applied to all aspects of society. With the continuous penetration of technology and digital theory, intelligent manufacturing, robotics, industrial monitoring, remote sensing, unmanned driving, medical diagnosis and other civil applications have developed rapidly. Among them, the research of surgical navigation application is also in constant practice and innovation. This article in the current sensor positioning technology and surgical navigation research, on the basis of analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of different sensor positioning, is proposed based on aruco marker infrared vision oral implant navigation research plan, and the simulation experiment, fixing the surgical instrument tracking, finally, the experimental results were analyzed and put forward the improvement scheme.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Lithium Battery Based on SSA-ELM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the weights and the thresholds of extreme learning machine (ELM) are no longer adjusted after random setting, which leads to the model easily falling into local minimum and affects the accuracy of the model, a ELM optimized by sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is proposed, in which the SSA is used to iterative search to find the optimal weights and thresholds of the ELM to improve the fitting ability. The simulation test and experimental comparison are carried out on the lithium battery public data set of the University of Maryland CALCE group. The simulation results show that compared with the ELM optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO-ELM) and the original ELM, the ELM optimized by SSA (SSA-ELM) has the closest prediction result of the remaining useful life(RUL) of lithium battery to the real value and has the smallest error, which proves that the optimization method is effective in predicting the RUL of lithium battery.

Author Keywords: Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Lithium Battery

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Electric Vehicle Handling Stability Based on Uncertainty Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In the optimization design of electric vehicle, the uncertainties in the assembly or manufacturing process rarely are taken into account, and the optimization results are lack of robustness. A robust design of electric vehicle is carried out considering the uncertain factors of the power battery system. Firstly, based on vehicle handling stability, three dynamics performance of electric vehicle, including vehicle lateral acceleration, vehicle yaw velocity and vehicle roll angle, are selected as the optimization objectives. The design variables include the structure size and position parameters of power battery system. Secondly, the adaptive simulated annealing algorithm and Taguchi method are used to optimize the power battery system of electric vehicle to improve the EV handling stability. Finally, the robust optimization results are verified applying the simulation model of electric vehicle. The results show that the electric vehicle based on the Taguchi method can effectively resist the impact of uncertainties of the power battery system.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition Method Based on Deep Learning in Electric Power Public Opinion Field
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Finding entity information quickly from the electric power public opinion field is difficult. The traditional language model can’t deal with the semantic information between contexts well, and it can’t get a good recognition result for polysemy and entity inclusion. To address this problem, we propose a RoBERTa-BilSTM-CRF model to extract relevant entities in the text. Through RoBERTa pre-training model, features are extracted by combining Chinese characters’ five strokes sequence and radical. We use various types of feature information for comprehensive feature extraction to solve the problem of incomplete and inaccurate information feature extraction caused by single-mode feature extraction. By adding the Attention mechanism to the model, long texts can learn more appropriate representation vectors during training. We adopt a position index manner to annotate sequence, which can reduce inclusion among annotated entities. The experimental results show that the accuracy of entity extraction is significantly improved, and the inclusion problem between entities is effectively solved.

Author Keywords: Electric Power Public Opinion Entity Recognition

articleTitle: Data Crawling and Research Based on Topic Web Crawler
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the popularity of big data, efficient acquisition of existing massive data and multi-angle analysis has become a key technology. In this paper, compared with the traditional general web crawler, the main web crawler strategy adopted in network crawling can be more efficient for grasping targets, so as to carry out data grasping operations more efficiently. Based on the film review data on Douban.com, this paper analyzes and studies the film review data without damaging the operation of the website. By using jieba, matplotlib, wordcloud and other libraries in python library, data can be visualized into wordcloud map, pie chart and line chart, which is helpful for users to see key words and the proportion of favorable and negative comments in movie works directly, which is of great significance to users’ preference selection. It also has certain reference significance for accurate software recommendation in the era of big data.

articleTitle: Message Passing Graph Neural Networks for Software Security Vulnerability Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the booming development of deep learning and machine learning, the use of neural networks for software source code security vulnerability detection has become a hot pot in the field of software security. As a data structure, graphs can adequately represent the complex syntactic information, semantic information, and dependencies in software source code. In this paper, we propose the MPGVD model based on the idea of text classification in natural language processing. The model uses BERT for source code pre-training, transforms graphs into corresponding feature vectors, uses MPNN (Message Passing Neural Networks) based on graph neural networks in the feature extraction phase, and finally outputs the detection results. Our proposed MPGVD, compared with other existing vulnerability detection models on the same dataset CodeXGLUE, obtain the highest detection accuracy of 64.34%.

articleTitle: Attention Mechanism Based Full-face Gaze Estimation for Human-computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Due to the expanding application field of gaze estimation, gaze estimation has become an important research topic in human-computer interaction and computer vision. Most of the current mainstream methods for gaze estimation during HCI are based on a sing-camera and single-screen system. In order to address the issues of gaze estimation for multi-camera multi-screen systems, this paper explores the use of a deep learning model, the residual neural network (ResNet50) plus an attention mechanism, to estimate the operator's point of gaze (PoG) on the screen in the flight simulator. First, the front face image is obtained from the three images by preprocessing, and then ResNet is used to regress the PoG. The results show that the inclusion of the attention mechanism enhances the network effect, in which the smallest prediction error is found for on-screen PoG using ResNet50+ECANet compared to SENet and CBAM.

articleTitle: Imaging Algorithm for Circular SAR Based on Geometric Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Circular synthetic aperture radar (CSAR) has the advantage of providing a comprehensive view of the scene. Back-projection (BP) algorithm and Fast factorized BP (FFBP) algorithm can be used for image reconstruction under imaging conditions with bandwidths and accumulation angles of any trajectory or size and is independent of the azimuth-invariant assumption, which are more suitable for CSAR imaging. However, the BP algorithm has a large computational amount, and the FFBP algorithm corresponds to the update of the image coordinate system, which increases the difficulty of image accumulation. To improve the speed and quality of CSAR imaging, this paper proposes a CSAR sub-aperture imaging method based on the geometry constraints. Firstly, the principle of coherence superposition of CSAR sub-aperture in the local quasi-polar coordinate system (LQPCS) is derived; secondly, the flow of imaging algorithm for CSAR based on geometric constraints is given; thirdly, The simulated imaging results verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Positioning and Mapping for Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence in society, the use of robots is becoming more and more extensive. The method of synchronous positioning and mapping with camera as sensor is an important one in SLAM technology. In this paper, combining vision sensor with embedded development board, the ORB-SLAM3 algorithm based on vision is studied and implemented. This paper introduces and describes each module in visual synchronous positioning and mapping, and presents an improved error matching elimination algorithm. Quality factor is introduced into feature point classification, and high-quality feature points are arranged in descending order according to quality level, which improves the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm. ORB-SLAM3 algorithm will be adopted as the implementation scheme, and the overall system flow of the algorithm will be described and analyzed. The raster map is used to replace the original point cloud map representation, so that the map display can be more intuitive and clear and reduce the map storage space, improve the algorithm running time consumption and the point cloud map occupies a large memory space and other problems. After that, an optimized algorithm of synchronous location and map building is implemented on iTop4412.

articleTitle: Explore the Application of Computer Network Technology in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In today's economic globalization, network technology has made the processing and transmission of information break through the limitations of time and geography, various Internet-based applications continue to emerge, and e-commerce as a new thing has also been greatly developed. However, while promoting the progress of human civilization, network technology has also brought security problems such as system vulnerabilities, hacker attacks, computer viruses, etc., which will seriously affect the healthy development of the Internet and restrict the promotion and popularization of various Internet applications such as e-commerce. Therefore, it is of far-reaching significance to study the application of computer network technology in e-commerce, especially in the capital flow, logistics and business flow of e-commerce.

articleTitle: Research on Semi-Supervised Text Classification Based on Graph Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Text classification is a basic task in natural language processing. Due to the sparsity of text data and the finiteness of tags, the feature construction method and the neural network used to learn features in text affect the subsequent classification effect. In order to make full use of text label data and improve the accuracy of text classification, we propose a semi-supervised text classification method combining topic information and graph attention network. Firstly, we construct text heterogeneous information graph by combining text self-information and additional information to better mine text semantics. Then, the Heterogeneous Graph Convolutional Network(HGCN) is used to learn the text graph. In particular, a two-layer attention mechanism is added to our method, including type-level attention and node-level attention. Through the attention mechanism, the model can understand the importance of different adjacent nodes and the importance of various types of information in the graph to the current node. A large number of experimental results show that our proposed model is significantly superior to other methods in three benchmark data sets.

articleTitle: Design of EOD Robot Based on Hybrid Control of Brain Wave and Remote Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to change the unfavorable situation of high error rate, poor adaptability and low safety in the operation of traditional EOD devices, a research and design of EOD robot based on hybrid control of brain waves and remote network is proposed. This paper firstly introduces the composition and detailed process control of the EEG basic device, and discusses the macro structure and control process principle of the remote network hybrid network control EOD robot. Further emphasis is placed on the mechanical structure, drive structure, perception structure, and various parts of the helmet-brain-computer interface in the hardware of the hybrid control EOD robot. This paper also discusses the detailed content of the software design of the hybrid control EOD robot, such as the program design of the microcontroller in the helmet and the software design of the remote control center. Finally, the paper discusses the security of the data transmission from the helmet to the remote control center, which can be effectively solved by the SM4 encryption algorithm. The actual simulation application shows that the EOD robot has the requirements of mixed control of local operator and remote network, and has good performance and high safety.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Mobile Robot Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: As a typical automatic handling tool in intelligent workshop, mobile robot plays an increasingly important role in intelligent production, and its path planning is the key to affect the material handling time and cost of intelligent workshop. Based on the analysis of the whole handling process of the workshop mobile robot, this paper finds that the driving distance and turning times are the main factors affecting the handling time. According to the walking distance and turning times of the mobile robot, the path planning model of the mobile robot with the shortest walking distance and the least turning times as the target is established. The ant colony algorithm is used to solve the model and the simulation results are verified. The results show that the ant colony algorithm can effectively complete the path planning of intelligent workshop mobile robot.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on Wavelet Transform and Residual Shrinkage Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Rolling bearings are frequently employed in machinery equipment, and the safely production of such equipment depend greatly on the properly work of bearing. Fault diagnosis of bearing is usually performed by means of vibration signal analysis, which are further divided into traditional analysis methods and machine learning based analysis methods. Traditional methods rely on expert knowledge, which makes it difficult to extract fault features, machine learning methods rely on huge volumes of data and need to eliminate the distraction of surrounding noise. This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on wavelet transform and deep residual shrinkage network. Firstly, transform the vibration signal into wavelet time-frequency map by wavelet transform method, and then expand data set by augment to create enough training samples, next, build a deep residual shrinkage network, and train the model for fault classification, thus implement the fault diagnosis task. Experiment shows that the accuracy of this model is superior to other comparable models, which reached 99.3% in low-noise environment, and 93.6% in high-noise environment.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Study on Friction Stir Lap Welding of Aluminum and Titanium Dissimilar Metal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Based on Abaqus software, a finite-element model was established to simulate the friction stir lap welding of aluminum and titanium dissimilar metal. Then the influence of rotational velocity for the lap interface and transient temperature field were simulated. The simulation results show that increasing the rotation speed can increase the friction thermal production between the rotational tool and material in unit time. The difference of the thermal input generated by friction between the rotating shoulder and the welded plate results in a bowl-like shape. Compared with the Al/Ti lap, the Ti/Al lap can guarantee enough thermal input and obtain good weldment quality under the reasonable welding parameters.

articleTitle: Student Behavior Analysis System Based on Kmeans Algorithm Under the Background of Smart Campus
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The development of information technology has made the management of students more systematic in colleges and universities. Student behavior information, such as grade information, trajectory information, competition information, and diversified student behavior information makes college management cumbersome. The application of big data technology can mine student behavior information and realize the construction smart campus. In this regard, this paper designs a student behavior analysis system, and uses the Kmeans algorithm to perform cluster analysis on the data of student behavior characteristics, which provide quantitative data support for the evaluation of scholarships and bursaries and the identification of poor students in the process of student management. The system is used to analyze student behavior, saving a lot of labor costs and providing scientific decision-making suggestions for student management.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method of Dynamic Source Routing Protocol in Flying Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Due to the efficient use of UAVs in several military and rescue applications, FANET (Flying Ad Hoc Network) offer a broad field for research and deployment. Drones have high maneuverability in 3D (three-dimensional) environments, and the low battery power of drones creates some problems, such as short usage time and ineffective routing. Providing a node routing protocol in FANET can effectively solve these problems. DSR (Dynamic Source Routing Protocol), as a classic on-demand routing protocol, can effectively save network resources in FANET. Therefore, this paper proposes a dynamic source routing protocol (WOA-DSR) based on the whale optimization algorithm (WOA) to provide an optimal route for FANET while saving energy. Finally, use OPNET modeler 14.5 to simulate WOA-DSR. The simulation results show that WOA-DSR is superior to DSR and FA-DSR in terms of average end-to-end delay, routing overhead and energy utilization.

articleTitle: Application of Stacking and Blending Ensemble Strategies in Breast Cancer Drug Candidates
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to select drugs that are effective against breast cancer and can be absorbed safely by humans, the composition and molecular structure of the drugs need to be analyzed. A regression prediction model based on the Blending strategy is proposed for the bioactivity of ER$\alpha$, the target of breast cancer treatment, and a classification prediction model based on the Stacking strategy is proposed for the ADMET(Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, Toxicity) properties to optimize the bioactivity and ADMET properties of ER$\alpha$ antagonists. The experimental results showed that 23 molecular structures with significant effects on bioactivity were selected by regression models, and the ensemble method based on the Blending strategy could better fit whether the molecular structure could inhibit ER$\alpha$ activity than other comparative models. The ensemble method based on the Stacking strategy was able to predict more accurately whether the drug could be a breast cancer drug candidate than other comparative models.

articleTitle: Research on the Integration of Management Accounting tools Based on Cloud Financial Sharing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Based on contingency theory and resource-based theory, this paper explores the relationship between management accounting tool integration, dynamic capabilities and enterprise value creation under big data cloud financial sharing, proposes research hypotheses, reasonably selects variables and designs questionnaires through literature and related materials, and uses structural equation model 129 samples from businesses were analyzed. The study found that the higher the integration degree of enterprise management accounting tools, the higher the enterprise value creation ability, and confirmed that dynamic ability played a partial mediating effect in it. The construction of enterprise management accounting tools and the integration framework of strategy, organization, technology and business process is conducive to the identification of internal and external environmental changes, the rational allocation of resources, and the establishment of learning organizations, thereby effectively stimulating enterprise innovation vitality and improving Enterprise risk management level and value creation capability.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Unsupervised Image Stitching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In today’s era, the field of image stitching is developing rapidly, and more and more image stitching has been proposed one after another. The effect of image stitching often determines the development of many downstream tasks, and the quality of images often plays a decisive role in the final stitching effect. However, the traditional feature-based image stitching technology depends on the quality of feature detection to a great extent and usually cannot stitching images with few features or low resolution. The lack of labeled image stitching data,it makes supervised methods unreliable. In order to solve the above problems, we proposed a new image stitching framework, the framework is composed of three parts, respectively is the transformation of homography, the stitching of structural and the optimization of content, the problems of large parallax, few features, low resolution and inconsistent color brightness in the process of image stitching are solved respectively. Finally, comparing the image stitching in this paper with SIFT and deep learning, it is proved that our method still has the best image mosaic effect in different scenes.

articleTitle: Recognition of Red Light Running Behavior of Electric Bicycles in Monitoring Video
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to accurately and efficiently identify the behavior of running red light by electric bicycles, this paper proposed an intelligent recognition model combining target detection and tracking, cross-road analysis and red light running decision. This model takes video frame sequence as input, firstly, electric bicycles and traffic lights are detected by YOLO network, and the bicycles are tracked in real time by DeepSort algorithm to get its trajectory. Then, LSTM is used to analysis the trajectory and distinguish whether there is behavior of crossing road. Finally, make decision of illegal behavior by integrating the state of signal light and the behavior of crossing road. In YOLO, MobileNet is introduced to replace the original CSPDarknet53 backbone, which greatly simplifies the network structure and improves detection efficiency. Dropout is introduced into LSTM to improve detection accuracy. Experimental results show that the optimized model achieves balance between accuracy and efficiency, can detect in real time on the experimental data set, and the final accuracy of recognition reach 94.9 %.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Network for Image Generation and Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Since a large number of convolutional neural network-based image generation and classification networks are now implemented in two separate models, this is a great waste of researcher’s effort and hardware resources, and also limits the scope of application of the models. In order to solve this problem, we propose a bidirectional network–-CGNet for image generation and classification tasks. Firstly, we design a low depth convolutional network model to ensure that the output of the terminal convolutional layer has enough information of the original image features. Secondly, we add a reverse data stream inside the network model to achieve the purpose of bidirectional network. Thirdly, using only one fully-connected layer after the terminal convolution layer, which reduces both the number of parameters in the model and the complexity of training. Finally, the training method of Generative Adversarial Nets (GAN) is used for the training of the inverse network model. The experimental results show that the classification accuracy of the proposed bidirectional network reaches over 82% on the CIFAR-10 dataset, and the generated images have clear semantics and high image quality.

articleTitle: Simulation and Result Analysis of Economic Loss after Hacker Attacks Server
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Due to the frequent changes of network technology and information technology to promote the overall development of society, the rapid expansion of network scale, the emergence of a large number of network hackers, viruses, etc., seriously threaten our information security, DDoS attack victims are difficult to defend against, and attacks can damage victims’ money, services and reputation. The attack caused the normal use. Deploying high-defense servers can indeed effectively defend against DDoS attacks, but the cost of high-defense servers is quite expensive; although deploying low-defense servers is low in cost, the defense effect is poor. Therefore, this paper conducts a simulation of the economic losses caused by hacking, aiming to help enterprises make decisions and adopt a more reasonable ratio of high-defense and low-defense servers, so that the maintenance cost of the server and the economic loss caused by the intrusion are the same. and minimum, the total economic cost is minimum.

articleTitle: Signed Network Embedding Based on Muti-attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In consideration of most signed network embeddings only focus on the low-order neighbors of the target node, they fail to make effective use of the high-order neighbors of the target node, and the link direction and sign of the node neighbors will affect the target node to varying degrees. Therefore, a SNEMA model using structure balance theory and multi head attention mechanism to aggregate high-order neighbors is proposed. The model gathers the information of high-order neighbors based on structure balance theory, captures node neighbors of different structure types through multi head attention mechanism, obtains the low-dimensional feature vector representation of nodes through processing and learning, and applies the obtained network representation to the downstream task of link prediction. The experimental results on four real social network data sets show that the network representation obtained by SNEMA model helps to improve the accuracy of link prediction, which shows that SNEMA model has achieved better results in signed network representation learning. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Research on Image Motion Deblurring Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: As the carrier of information, images can be used to obtain all kinds of important information. With the gradual progress of science and technology, people have higher and higher demand for image quality. However, affected by various reasons, the image will show varying degrees of information loss, resulting in image degradation. Therefore, this paper has done the following research on the motion blur of the image. This research takes the Generative Adversarial Networks as the main framework. First, a shallow feature extraction is carried out on the blurred image, and the Adaptive Residual Block is used as our encoder. The Adaptive Residual Block combines the Deformable Convolution Module, which can automatically adjust the size of the convolution kernel according to the deformable information of the motion blurred image, greatly improving the reconstruction ability of the image. Finally, the image is decoded by Transposed Convolution, and finally the blurred image is generated. In this study, PatchGAN network is used as our discriminator, which has good discriminating ability compared with other discriminator networks. The results of comparative tests show that the PSNR and SSIM of this algorithm are improved by 4.4% and 3.4% compared with other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Scheduling Algorithm Based on Greedy Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data and the popularity of smart phones, the impact of cloud computing on people’s daily life is increasing, and the improvement of living standards has also led to the rapid development of the level of science and technology. Cloud computing resource scheduling algorithm has always been the focus of cloud computing scientists. How to shorten the task completion time, improve the utilization of resources, reduce the energy consumption of the server and ensure the user QoS has been a hot topic in the field of cloud computing. This paper uses Java cloud computing simulation platform – CloudSim simulation platform. On the basis of CloudSim, create tasks with attributes such as instruction length, file size, and virtual resources including attributes such as memory, bandwidth and execution speed. In this experiment, the total execution time from transmission to completion on a single virtual resource is calculated according to the tasks and various attributes of virtual resources, and the total execution time is greedy, and the best allocation method with the least total execution time is selected. The time and the total execution time of the total transmission time and the shortest time are achieved. Under the condition of ensuring the user QoS, the load balancing is achieved.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Automation System with the Distribution Network System in Power Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The intelligent distribution network is an important foundation and support for the smart grid, and it has covered substations at all levels. The smart substation technology general provides the definition of a smart substation, which can support real-time automatic control and intelligent adjustment of the power grid as needed. It has online analysis and decision-making, collaborative mutual aid and other functions. However, due to the constraints of the existing optical cable conditions, construction progress, equipment replacement cycle and other factors, the existing optical network still has some weak points. So, the existing equipment and operation and maintenance methods cannot predict these weak points in advance. In order to meet the needs of power system automation and safe operation of unattended substations, an object-oriented design specification is implemented. In this paper, the project aims to change the development model of future power systems by utilizing smart grids. The rise of smart grid and intelligent transmission network has further promoted the construction of distribution network automation. At present, the State Grid Corporation of China is conducting pilot work of smart grid construction in four cities including Beijing, Hangzhou, Xiamen and Yinchuan. China Southern Power Grid Corporation has comprehensively built transmission network automation in Guangzhou and Shenzhen. Strengthening the construction of transmission network and implementing automation of transmission network are of great significance for improving the reliability of power supply. The system could ensure the healthy and sustainable development of social economy, and promoting the construction of smart grid.

articleTitle: Study on Impact of Power Battery System Parameters on Electric Vehicle Dynamics Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The existing study of electric vehicle does not analyze the impact on the structure size and the position of power battery system to vehicle dynamics performance. A virtual model of electric vehicle including in the power battery system, the front and rear suspension system, the steering system and other chassis subsystems is built using the software of ADAMS/VIEW. The power battery system and the key points of vehicle are parameterized in the vehicle model. By changing the size parameters and the positioning parameters of electric vehicle power battery system, the vehicle dynamics performance analysis is carried out, and the characteristic of the electric vehicle lateral acceleration are obtained. The simulation results are used to analyze electric vehicle dynamics performance considering the power battery system parameters.

articleTitle: Research on the Cooperation between English Teachers and IAP Teachers in English Major Education Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The work of ideological and political(IAP) education should not be limited to specific IAP theory courses. It is necessary to strengthen the coordination and cooperation of various majors, and seize the opportunity to carry out IAP education related to the professional teaching content in the teaching of professional courses, so as to guide students to better understand and use professional knowledge. And at the same time, promoting the penetration of ideological and political education concepts in professional course education will not only help each course meet the educational requirements, but also improve the effect of collaborative education. The penetration of IAP teaching in this paper is reflected in the combination of English courses and IAP courses. By analyzing the survey data of students in a university through data mining related technologies of big data, the way and the effectiveness of IAP education are founded. Based on these, the paper puts forward the collaborative education methods between English teachers and ideological and political teachers.

articleTitle: The Focus of Dual-Frequency Induced Polarization Electric Field Based on Intelligent Algorithm in Coal Mine Electrical Exploration
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: As the most important and dangerous front-end production link, coal mining operations will inevitably face geological disasters such as water inrush, rock burst, collapse, and fire, posing a great threat to the life and safety of miners. Among the five major geological disasters (gas, dust, water, fire, roof) in coal mines, the threat of flooding is very serious and it is one of the main disasters in coal mines. The research and development of dual-frequency excitation technology and its application in coal mine exploration have realized the elimination of potential safety hazards, improved the work efficiency and safety factor of prospectors, and realized the automated operation of the exploration process. This article explores the electric field of the intelligent algorithm's focused dual-frequency induced polarization method in coal mine electrical exploration, and summarizes some of the advantages of the intelligent algorithm's focused dual-frequency induced polarization method in coal mine surveying on related materials, and then conducts related experiment, through the experiment of focusing on the dual-frequency IP method in the coal mine survey, obtained the result, in the abnormal point detection experiment, the change trend of the two curves is the same, the increase is more obvious at 1.3-1.5m, and at 1.5m When reaching the limit value, when it exceeds 1.5m, it starts to fall. It shows that when there is a water-bearing anomalous body directly in front of the tunneling section, the measurement results of the two survey lines are roughly the same. Compared with the no anomaly body, the apparent resistivity and the apparent amplitude frequency both change significantly, and reach the extreme in a certain direction. However, the actual anomalous body is located 1.0m directly in front of the tunneling section, which means that the actual position of the anomaly cannot be determined based on the apparent resistivity and the extreme point position of the apparent amplitude frequency.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Ant Colony Clustering Algorithm and Application in the TSP
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Clustering is the process of partitioning or grouping a given set of patterns into disjoint clusters. Clustering has been a widely studied problem in a variety of application domains including data mining, knowledge discovery, artificial intelligence and etc. As a swarm-intelligent method, the ant colony clustering algorithm (ACCA) is inspired by the behavior of ant colonies. In the ACCA, ants are allowed to move randomly, pick up and drop objects in clusters at certain probability, which depends on similarity with surrounding objects. Ant Colony optimization (ACO) is being used by many applications for past few years. In this paper, an effective clustering algorithm based Ant Colony optimization (ACO), in which adaptive strategy is integrated, is proposed. ACCA is applied to solving TSP. The experiment results indicate that the proposed algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Financial Analysis of Industrial Software Enterprise Based on Python Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In the context of the era of big data, data, as a new factor of production, is being valued by more and more enterprises. Enterprises have used big data technology to tap the potential value behind the data, and it has been widely used in the fields of financial analysis and decision-making. In particular, the advantages of data processing tools in enterprise financial data processing are the direction of data processing, analysis and decision-making for enterprises now and in the future. This paper mainly analyzes the financial indicators of QY industrial software companies by using the Python data processing function, and analyzes the reasons for the financial problems of QY industrial software companies by establishing a DuPont analysis system. development to provide relevant advice. this paper adopts three methods: literature research method, interdisciplinary research method and case analysis method to deeply study the application process of big data technology in corporate financial decision-making. The study finds that the application of big data technology in corporate financial decision-making process is mainly reflected in Four aspects, one is data collection; the other is data storage; the third is financial analysis; the fourth is decision support. Introduce big data technology into the financial decision-making process of enterprises, broaden the channels of data collection, enrich financial analysis and decision-making methods, and provide strong support for enterprises to formulate more accurate and effective financial decision-making plans.

articleTitle: Research on Production Process Control Method of Discrete Manufacturing Digital Workshop
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the deep integration of the new generation of information technology and manufacturing industry represented by cloud computing, big data, Internet of things and artificial intelligence, a new round of industrial revolution has swept across. The outstanding characteristics of discrete manufacturing workshops are multiple varieties, small batches, long production cycles, and many uncertain factors in the production process. In view of the current problems of incomplete information collection, opaque production monitoring, unintelligent material distribution, and unsystematic quality traceability in discrete manufacturing workshops, a data-driven technical framework for production process management and control in discrete manufacturing digital workshops is proposed, Based on the Internet of things technology, it realizes the online perception of production factors in the manufacturing process, the online decision-making of production instructions and the accurate execution of production tasks. Finally, taking the gear workshop of a heavy equipment manufacturing enterprise as the object, the prototype system development and application verification of the proposed method are carried out.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Agricultural Products Traceability System on Mobile Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In recent years, accidents related to the quality and safety of agricultural products in China have continued to occur, and the construction of a traceability system for agricultural products has become an effective means to ensure the quality and safety of agricultural products. Based on the analysis of the demand for agricultural product traceability and the research on the traceability system of agricultural products, this paper designs and develops the traceability system of agricultural products, realizes the collection of agricultural material information by mobile terminals, tracks the distribution process of agricultural products, and scans the code to query the key information of the whole process of agricultural products from planting to sales. At the same time, when there is a quality problem with agricultural products, the agricultural products are positioned by reverse traceability of agricultural products and the problem agricultural products are quickly recalled.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Fast Spectral Peak Search Algorithm Based on Uniform Circular Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems that the search time of uniform circular array is too long in the process of spectral peak search using multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm and the success rate of conventional genetic algorithm for spectral peak search is low, a fast spectral peak search algorithm is proposed. The algorithm first obtains the spatial spectrum estimation function through MUSIC algorithm, and then uses Bee Evolutionary Genetic Algorithm to realize the fast and accurate search of spectral peaks. Compared with the time-consuming traversal search method of MUSIC algorithm and conventional genetic algorithm with low success rate, this algorithm not only shortens the time of spectral peak search, but also greatly improves the success rate of spectral peak search.

articleTitle: Research on Used Car Valuation Problem Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: At present, the number of motor vehicles in China is increasing day by day, and the second-hand car trading market is also expanding. Due to the characteristics of “one vehicle, one condition”, it is necessary to take into account the basic configuration and use of the car body in the evaluation of used cars, and the price of used cars is difficult to estimate. Firstly, this paper classifies the used car transaction cycle based on six machine learning models AdaBoost, GBDT, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost and Decision tree, filters out the key factors affecting the used car transaction on five types of data sets, compares and filters the key factors based on multiple machine learning models, and constructs a prediction model based on LightGBM prediction model based on these key factors. Moreover, we have conducted extensive experiments to demonstrate that the model can achieve a better expected effect on the formulation of used car sales strategy.

articleTitle: Kalman Filtering Jitter Cancellation Based on Lidar Localization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Positioning using lidar is different from GPS, which directly obtains must coordinates of the earth’s surface, and from IMU and odometers, which obtain position data through integration. It involves mapping an area before using sensor data such as lidar, cameras and IMU. In this paper, the study of lidar and camera, odometer as sensors is done by introducing the calibration of sensors, which are used in various devices in recent times and the data obtained are processed by using kalman filtering. By comparison, it is found that the data processing by kalman filtering makes the data smoother and the prediction more accurate. This enhances the application in the data processing process. It is also found through analysis that the use of kalman filtering is more productive in the process of using kalman filtering due to the loosely coupled relationship between various sensors, thus providing a new way of thinking for research in this field.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach to Terracotta Warriors’ Facial Recovery and Quadratic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Facial restoration and animation of degraded images of Terracotta Warriors are important for enhancing the vitality and promotion of cultural relics. In this paper, based on a deep learning theoretical framework, blind facial restoration is performed on degraded images of terracotta warriors using rich and diverse facial priors in pre-trained generative adversarial networks. The facial prior is involved in the image generation process through the spatial feature transformation layer to achieve a good balance of realism and fidelity in the terracotta warrior restoration process. The anime style migration algorithm is used to realize the animalization of the terracotta warrior restoration image by learning the style features of the anime reference image and fitting the style migration process. The experimental results show that the method in this paper achieves facial recovery of the terracotta warriors with high fidelity; the generated secondary terracotta heads have obvious anime style and the content information remains highly consistent with the original images.

articleTitle: Application of Sentiment Classification of Weibo Comments Based on TextCNN Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The Internet has become the main medium for the dissemination of network public opinion. By analyzing the emotional development trend of emergencies, it is possible to explore the evolution of public opinion and identify potential risks, and to provide decision support for the guidance and control of public opinion. This paper combines Word2vec and network and text convolutional neural network (Convolutional Neural Network, TextCNN) model to achieve text sentiment classification for Weibo comments. Formalize the comment text, and segment the processed data through the stuttering word segmentation library, that is, extract the keyword words, and use the Word2vec tool to train the word vector for each word segmentation, and obtain the word embedding weight matrix. The embedding layer of the CNN model. In this paper, the comment text is normalized, and the processed data is segmented through Jieba, that is, the keyword words are extracted, and the Word2vec tool is used to train the word vector for each word segmentation, and the embedding of the word embedding weight matrix CNN model is obtained.

articleTitle: Locating Buffer Overflow Vulnerabilities Based on Sensitive Functions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Buffer overflow vulnerability (BOV) is a kind of dangerous vulnerability among software vulnerabilities. BOV is widespread in software programs and pose a serious security threat. In this paper, we focus on the functions that trigger buffer vulnerabilities, and the complexity of the code itself, and construct a multi-polar vulnerability code graph that can characterize the vulnerable code. Then build a list of sensitive keywords, locate sensitive fields through the list, obtain keyword-related subgraphs, and analyze data control relationships to detect vulnerabilities. Through experiments, our method can detect BOV triggered by sensitive functions, showing the effectiveness of the proposed keyword-based vulnerability in locating sensitive field functions. And it’s also useful for deep learning in vulnerability detection.

articleTitle: Pricing and Service Provision in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the development of wireless network technologies, the number of mobile devices (MDs), such as smartphones and wearable devices, is growing at an unprecedented rate. In the 5G networks, mobile devices obtain wireless network services from the Internet Service Providers (ISPs) by signing contracts. Generally speaking, there are usually more than one ISP in the network service market. Therefore, mobile users (MUs) face the difficulty of selecting network services from these ISPs. In this paper, we consider a network service market with MUs selecting network services from one ISP who prices are set differently for different MUs. We model the interaction between the ISP and MUs as a Stackelberg game, under which the prices of the network service of the ISP are firstly determined, and the MUs make decisions based on the network service prices. We applied the backward induction way to prove the unique existence of the equilibrium. Simulation results are provided to show the analysis results.

articleTitle: Impact of Transformational Leadership and Big Data Analytics Capability on Supply Chain Innovativeness
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Many firms attach great importance to innovative supply chain. It is a management practice to promote innovative supply chain culture through supply chain leadership behavior. Big data is the engine of the development of digital economy. Big data analytics capability can well help firms transform the massive and complicated big data into useful knowledge, and then serve leaders’ decision-making. The current study aims to bridge the gap in understanding how transformational leadership and big data analytics impact supply chain innovativeness. Using hierarchical Regression methods, results from a survey of 144 firms in China supported the hypotheses. The study findings show that there is significant positive relationship between transformational leadership and supply chain innovativeness. Moreover, big data analytics capability exhibited a moderating effect on transformational leadership - innovativeness relationship. Theoretically, this research has synthesized literature and develops an integrated research model that combines leader style and technology factors altogether to investigate supply chain innovativeness. Hence, we believe that our results will be useful for managers who are highly optimistic about the leadership role and focus on supply chain innovativeness, big data analytics, big data analysis technology capability, and big data analysis management capability.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Cross-Domain Person Re-Identification Method Combining Improved Squeeze and Excitation Block
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The performance of the existing unsupervised cross-domain pedestrian re-identification methods is degraded by the domain gap and unalignment problems. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an unsupervised cross-domain person re-identification method combining improved squeeze and excitation blocks. First, in feature extraction using the ResNet-50 network, improved squeeze and excitation blocks are used among the backbone network to mine fine-grained information. Second, to improve the quality of clustering clusters, an awareness instance selection method is then used to suppress noise interference and remove unreliable instances, and the awareness instance selection method selects images with reliable labels for model training. The experimental results show that the new method designed in the paper improves the accuracy of mAP by 9.4% on the target domain Market-1501 dataset and 6.9% on the target domain DukeMTMC-ReID dataset compared with other typical methods.

articleTitle: Optimal Pricing Scheme for NetworkService Provisioning in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the advancements of communication technologies, various numbers of mobile devices (MDs) are growing fast. In the current 5G or future networks, MDsget network services from mobile network operators (MNOs) by paying some money. To meet the growing demand of mobile device users (MDUs), the MNOs have to expand their network capacity or use pricing tool to control the admission of MDUs such that their revenue can be maximized. In addition, the MDUs may have different evaluations for the network services. For example, some MDUs may pay more attention to the obtained reward while some ones may focus more on the network delay. In this paper, we consider a 5G networking architecture with one MNO provisioning services to MDUs whose preferences for network services are different. Simulation results are presented to analyze the obtained analysis results. The results show that the MNO can leverage the different types of MDUs to get more revenue and set higher price. This provides some important implications for the design of the 5G networking systems.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Remote Control Intelligent Vehicle in Distributed Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Driverless vehicles is the main body for urban intelligent transportation system in the future. But as a user, how to use and control driverless vehicles in a complicated distributed environment is more and more becoming an important issue. It is very necessary to carry out remote real-time control of driverless vehicle in complex distributed environment. This paper designs and implements a remote control system for driverless intelligent vehicle under two different operating system vxworks and linux. Users can login the internet of things control center based on linux from the embedded devices based on vxworks real-time operating system which will control the driverless intelligent vehicle by sending the remote commands in real time. The experiments show that in the distributed environment, the internet of things control center can receive the remote commands sent by users and send these commands to the driverless vehicles so as it can do the corresponding actions. This will be realized by the wireless network and then users can control the driverless vehicles in real time.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Peer CSR Tone Based on Python—from the Perspective of Green Innovations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Text sentiment analysis is a crucial part of natural language processing, and Chinese Jieba Segmentation based on Python Technology is an important preprocessing operation of natural language processing. We use python web crawler technology to perform samples pretreating, obtain the number of positive and negative words and measure corporate social responsibility tone of peer companies (Peer CSR tone hereafter). On this basis, we empirically tests the impact of peer CSR tone and target companies’ green innovations. We find that peer CSR tone has a significantly positive relationship with green innovations of target companies. The analysis of the effects channel suggests that their relationship can be realized through social learning mechanisms and social competition mechanisms. Further, compared with non-state-owned enterprises, the peer CSR tone has a more significant impact on the green innovations of state-owned enterprises. The research is of great significance to expand the application of python web crawler technology and enhance corporate green innovations. It is also a further application of Python in the field of text sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Based Mutation Chaos Particles Swarm Optimization of Vanet Performance in Qos Constraint
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Confronted of the complex urban environment, the basic safety message (BSM) broadcasted by safety applications can effectively prevent traffic accidents. Nevertheless, factors such as hidden terminals, concurrent transmission collisions, and path loss due to channel fading during transmission can affect the quality of service (QoS) for security applications. Under the premise of ensuring the safety application QoS requirements, this paper proposes a mutation chaos particles swarm optimization(MCPSO) algorithm to dynamically adjust the transmission parameters for maximizing the utilization of transmission capacity. The experimental results show that the transmission parameters optimized by the algorithm have better effects in the utilization of transmission channel resources and the reliability of security applications.
