articleTitle: Heterologous Image Registration Based on DartNet53 Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Heterologous image matching is a popular academic topic in the world. Its commonly used data carriers are infrared and visible light images. Deep learning is machine learning applied to deep neural networks. As a technology emerging in recent years, it has been widely used in speech recognition, image processing and other fields and achieved good results. The main direction of this topic is the detection and matching of heterogeneous images based on deep learning. Different from traditional methods, this subject adopts darknet53, a light-weight and high-speed neural network, so as to achieve the purpose of optimizing the detection and matching effect and prove it through experiments. Today, deep learning and multi-disciplinary cross-matching have become a hot topic among hot topics. The application of low-cost, high-efficiency artificial intelligence networks in multi-scenario environments has become a consensus pursued by the scientific community.

articleTitle: Research on Unloading Switching Strategy of Vehicular Edge Computing Based on Urgency
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Vehicular Edge Computing solves the problem of high delay in previous vehicle-mounted cloud computing by using the feature that edge servers are close to vehicle-mounted terminals and can provide computing services nearby. However, with the increasing amount of data processed by mobile terminals and the scale of computing, new requirements are brought about for task processing delay and task urgency scheduling. In this paper, a computing switching strategy is proposed to prioritize the allocation of computing resources needed for urgent tasks, reduce the completion time of urgent tasks, and make urgent tasks complete faster. The simulation experiment based on MATLAB platform shows that the switching times of urgent tasks are reduced by 50.94% and the average completion time of urgent tasks is reduced by 54.92%.

articleTitle: An Electronic Circuit Principle and Test Platform for Negative Group Delay and Superluminal Propagation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Group velocity superluminal phenomenon, also known as negative group delay or negative group velocity phenomenon, refers to a group of envelope signals at the output end of the medium before the input, on the time axis, is the envelope on leaving the medium before entering the medium, but this does not violate causality. Based on the waveguide theory of negative group delay, this paper uses the transfer function, amplitude response and phase shift response of the electronic circuit to achieve the regulation of group velocity. The actual electronic circuit is made and the testing platform and method are built. The phenomenon of negative group delay is preliminarily realized, which lays a foundation for the subsequent research. As an envelope that can carry and transmit information, the study of negative group velocity is of great significance to the improvement of signal transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis of A RC Loop with Negative Group Delay
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In human history, the exploration of the speed of light although difficult but continuous, reflects the spirit of human exploration of the unknown world. With the rapid development of the information age, the demand for signal transmission is getting higher and higher now, and the traditional amplitude-frequency response is no longer enough to meet the demand. Therefore, the focus is gradually shifted to the study of phase frequency, among which the study of faster-than-light speed and negative group delay has very important value. In this paper, based on the existing second order negative group delay circuit, the design necessity of high frequency suppression in the circuit is analyzed. To get more effect in advance, with the method of series multiple circuit in series, the transfer function of the amplitude response and phase shift and group delay integral and local in-depth analysis, although the effect is satisfactory in advance, but the response amplitude of the pulse signal distortion on impact, working bandwidth is also nots allow to ignore. The research results of this paper can provide basic theoretical results for subsequent in-depth research, optimization design and innovative design of circuits, and provide more assistance and lay a foundation for further research.

articleTitle: Product Traceability System Based on B/S Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The traditional traceability mechanism of manufacturing products is backward, and it is not fully connected and coordinated with the traceability information management in the Internet era, resulting in problems such as slow information transmission and high retention cost, poor confidentiality of enterprise privacy data and difficult recall of defective products. In view of the above problems and difficulties, a manufacturing product traceability system based on b\/s architecture is designed and developed. Design a product traceability system scheme of a manufacturing enterprise based on b\/s architecture, build a collaborative management architecture of web management and sqlserver2008r2 database, and realize the core functions of the traceability system, such as product traceability query and OCR intelligent identification, as well as the basic functions of adding, deleting, and modifying personnel management, product supply chain management, and warehouse management. Solve the problem of information transmission and retention, and strengthen the confidentiality of core data. At the same time, the traceability system is simple and easy to use, with low operation and maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Research on Setting of Two Firewall Rules Based on Ubuntu Linux System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: "Security first" is the most concerned issue of Linux administrators. Security refers to the integrity of data. The authentication security and integrity of data are higher than the privacy security of data. Firewall is used to realize the function of access control under Linux. It is divided into hardware or software firewall. No matter in which network, the firewall must work at the edge of the network. Our task is to define how the firewall works. This is the firewall's policies and rules, so that it can detect the IP and data in and out of the network. At present, there are three or four layers of firewalls on the market, which are called network layer firewalls, and seven layers of firewalls, which are actually the gateway of the agent layer. But for the seven layer firewall, no matter what your source port or target port, source address or target address is, it will check all your things. Therefore, the seven layer firewall is more secure, but it brings lower efficiency. Therefore, the usual firewall schemes on the market are a combination of the two. And because we all need to access from the port controlled by the firewall, the work efficiency of the firewall has become the most important control of how much data users can access. This paper introduces two types of firewalls iptables and TCP_Wrappers. What are the differences between the use policies, rules and structures of the two firewalls? This is the problem to be discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Data Processing Scheme Based on Mashup Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the improvement of the level of logistics informatization, the traditional stand-alone data processing method faces challenges in data storage, data loading, and data query in a massive data environment. How to effectively deal with the problem of insufficient performance of traditional data processing methods has become the top priority. Therefore, on account of the characteristics of logistics business data, particularly the time-series attribution, this paper proposes a massive structured data processing scheme and builds a mashup architecture based on the IoTDB time-series database and MPP database. First, the overall frame design of this scheme and the applicability analysis based on IoTDB technology are expounded. Then the comparison and analysis are given between the traditional data processing method and the proposed scheme. The experimental results show that our scheme performs higher efficiency than traditional routines in data processing such as data loading and data query. This research can provide some technical support and guidance for logistics data management and application.

articleTitle: Trajectory Differential Privacy Protection with Regional Center of Gravity
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In the process of location-based services, privacy preserving is a key challenge when releasing and analyzing data. Most of the existing methods added noise to all the locations in the trajectory, which will reduce the availability after data protection. Aiming at the data availability of trajectory privacy protection, a method about trajectory data differential privacy protection with regional center of gravity is proposed. Firstly, the position points in the trajectory are sampled, and the phased activity area is excavated to form an irregular polygon; Then, calculates the center of gravity (CG) of polygon and generates a new trajectory by using the CG points; After that, Laplace mechanism noise is added to the new trajectory to achieve the purpose of trajectory privacy protection. The experiment conducted on the real datasets shows that the proposed method can protect the privacy of trajectory data and further improve the availability of data.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Car Controlled by Voice
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In recent years, it is a focus that remotely control driverless car by voice for intelligent transportation system in the future. This paper designed a system, using a LD3320 speech recognition module controlled by a STM32 chip and achieved the real-time control for the driverless car in remote mode. Through the zigbee wireless transmission, the voice parsing instructions are sent to the self-driving car by the upper computer with two serial ports. When the remote intelligent car gets the commands, it will control the rotation of the motor forward, backward, turn left or right and stop. The experimental results show when the user issues voice commands, the upper computer can obtain the best matching results in real-time and send them to the self-driving car by zigbee wireless transmission, and the car can accurately make corresponding actions.

articleTitle: Error Analysis and Improvement Method of Antenna Polarization Measured by Three-antenna Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Polarization describes the trajectory of the space electromagnetic field vector in the transmission cross section with the time changing. It reflects the regularity of electromagnetic wave vector changing over time. Three-antenna method is a kind of commonly used method which can measure antenna polarization parameters accurately. Considering the wall reflection in the anechoic chamber, the geometrical optics method is combined with three-antenna method for error analysis and correction in this paper. Measurement results and simulation results show that this method improves the measurement method of characteristic of antenna’s polarization and improves the accuracy of the results.

articleTitle: Research on Dry Beach Length Measurement Based on Improved Mask R-CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The length of dry beach is one of the important parameters reflecting the stability of tailings dam, So dry beach length is an important aspect of tailings pond safety monitoring. In order to measure the dry beach length accurately, a deep learning-based dry beach length measurement method is proposed. The method is divided into 4 parts: (1) Install a camera to obtain tailings pond images; (2) Use the improved Mask R-CNN algorithm to train a network model that can identify the waterline position; (3). Perform contour extraction, obtain pixel coordinates and filter out the minimum pixel ordinate; (4). According to the monocular visual ranging model, the transformation formula between image coordinate system and dry beach coordinate system is obtained, and the length of dry beach is obtained by putting the minimum pixel coordinate into the transformation formula. Experimental results show that the model can accurately measure dry beach length with an error of less than 2.7%.

articleTitle: Simulation of College Students Returning Home During the Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: When the epidemic hit, returning home is facing tremendous pressure from all sides. Based on the background of real events, the research method from microscopic individual simulation to macro rule exploration is adopted to simulate and explore the centralized isolation, infection on the way, and the impact on the spread of the epidemic in the process of returning college students under different policies during the epidemic control period, and at the same time, combined with the comparative analysis of management pressure, student pressure and public opinion pressure, the mathematical model is compared with the simulation results to verify the effect of the model. The simulation results focus on the comparative analysis of data performance, and some laws are summarized from them for decision-making reference and publicity and epidemic prevention.

articleTitle: Ideological and Political Teaching of English Based on Data Mining (DM)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: DM technology has a very wide application prospect and valuable promotion, and has obtained very good benefits in many industries and fields. However, in sharp contrast, the application of DM in the field of higher education is far from enough, and there is still a big gap compared with other fields. Based on current situation, this paper studies and analyzes the evaluation of English ideological and political teaching based on DM, and discusses the construction of English ideological and political TE system and the process and method of DM; The decision tree algorithm is proposed, and the application of DM in the evaluation of Ideological and political teaching of English course is analyzed. The evaluation of Ideological and political teaching of HC in a university is tested by means of data preprocessing. In order to prove the effectiveness of the whole mining results of the computing system, the weighted effectiveness algorithm is used; the calculation results show that the accuracy of the TE DM system is relatively high, that is, the performance is relatively good and can really reflect the ideological and political teaching in college English course.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Helicopter Data Link Availability Based on Markov
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Data link is a communication and command system that transmits and distributes formatted messages, which can connect the originally independent combat platforms with each other. The high reliability service provided by the high availability helicopter data link is the guarantee of the combat command, so it is an urgent need to evaluate the availability of the helicopter data link system. Based on the availability theory and Link-16 data link technology, this paper presents a Markov steady-state availability model for evaluating the availability of data link systems. The experimental results show that the steady-state availability model and service availability model of the proposed data link system have certain credibility and correctness. This provides an operational method for the usability evaluation of data link network system, and has a certain reference value.

articleTitle: DSLCD-based Tunnel Secondary Lining Cavities Detection in Ground Penetrating Radar Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Because the depth is large, the detection area is wide, the interference is much, and the discrimination depends on expert experience, it is difficult to detect cavities inside the secondary lining of the tunnel efficiently. In order to solve this problem, we propose an end-to-end improved Faster R-CNN based network model named Deep Secondary Lining Cavity Detection (DSLCD) network. The model is divided into three parts: the feature extraction network, the region proposal network, and the classification and regression network. In the feature extraction network, a Balanced Feature Pyramid is used to strengthen the multi-layer features, while in the region suggestion network, the Guided Anchoring method is used to improve the model’s adaptability to the various size of the secondary lining voids target and to enhance the accuracy of the secondary lining voids target positioning by optimizing the ROI alignment process. The experimental results show that the DSLCD network has a decent detection accuracy on our GPR image dataset containing both reinforced concrete and plain concrete, which meets the engineering application requirements.

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain in College Network Ideological and Political Education
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: At present, the model of “Internet+” has been integrated into every aspect of social life, and the era of big data has accelerated the two-way process of social networking and network socialization. As another disruptive technology after cloud computing, Internet of things and big data, blockchain technology has highlighted its application value in many fields. Therefore, the discussion on the development and application of blockchain technology in the field of education has attracted much attention. This paper deeply discusses the application, approach and method of block chain technology in the network ideological and political education in universities, as well as the practical approach to the construction of application scenarios.

articleTitle: Design of Reservoir Safety Early Warning System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In order to realize the timeliness and accuracy of monitoring and early warning of reservoir hydrological information, and to fully protect the safety of people’s lives and property downstream, a reservoir safety early warning system based on meteorological big data is researched and designed. Use a certain web crawler tool to crawl the meteorological data of a certain reservoir, clean and normalize the data and store it in the database, use the web crawler technology to analyze the crawled data, and measure and control the current real-time hydrological data of the reservoir combined with the Internet of Things. Through the big data Spark parallel framework and GBDT algorithm, the change trend and main causes of meteorological rainfall and the storage capacity of a certain reservoir are analyzed, and the future development of the storage capacity of the reservoir is predicted and early warning according to the current environmental parameters. The application development shows that the use of big data algorithm technology to predict the future of the reservoir once an emergency occurs, the system can automatically alarm and notify the management personnel, which makes the reservoir dam safe and efficient before the problem occurs.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection and Target Tracking Based on Person Re-identification in Crowded Crowd
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: As a high-level task of computer vision, pedestrian recognition and target tracking involves many application scenarios has great research significance and practical value. In this paper, we use the Repulsion Loss to solve the problem of the non-maximum suppression operation in the post-processing phase of target detection is sensitive to the threshold value in the crowded and obstructed pedestrian scenarios, which results in mis-judgement and missed detection of the target. In order to solve the undetected pedestrian problem in the improved YOLOV3, we added a deformable convolution to the Mask R-CNN algorithm, which can better meet and adapt to the scale changes of natural pedestrians. The experimental results show that the mAP of the improved YOLOV3 increases from 68% to 73.4%. The mAP of the improved Mask R-CNN increased from 85% to 87.5%. We also present a pedestrian recognition GCPRN, to overcome the problem of insufficient representation of pedestrian appearance features in deep sort target tracking algorithm, we proposed a target tracking FRTN network. The experimental results indicated that the FRTN network is more effective than Deep Sort algorithm on MOTP and MOTA.

articleTitle: Research on the Development strategy of Vocational Undergraduate Education in the Context of Big Data and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the deep integration of big data, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, Internet of Things and education, higher vocational education, especially at the undergraduate level, is facing important internal and external changes. China's vocational undergraduate education is still in the early stage of development, the practice of running schools has not made breakthrough, there are some key problems such as the supply of vocational undergraduate education system "lag", the development path "lost", the goal "fuzzy", the concept of prejudice "generalization". Therefore, it is urgent to formulate the strategy of niche separation in higher vocational education in China. Adhere to the combination of "crossing the river by feeling the stones" and top-level design, improve the timeliness of institutional supply; To establish a "two-dimensional progressive" promotion mechanism for the linkage of ministries and provinces, and scientifically establish the main channel of development; Correctly handle the dialectical relationship between "change" and "constant", make clear the direction of running school and orientation of training; Give full play to the role of "leading goose" of vocational undergraduate education, enhance the attraction of vocational education. Comprehensively promote the steady and long-term development of vocational undergraduate education.
